component: Panels yield before the primary region (default sized against panel minimums, equal reserve including the rail, dockable floor, one stacked scroller)
explanation: CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (CHESS-WORKSPACE.md, workspaceLayout.ts). Extends FB-0015, whose draft sized the default against the panels' PREFERRED widths. Evidence: at about 1180 wide that left the board small while panels sat wide, and a default floor of 320 pushed both panels into drawers in a band just above the stacking threshold. Final rules: (1) the responsive default is sized against the panels' MINIMUM widths and panels then grow into what is left up to their preferred width; (2) the default's floor is what still docks at the minimums, so the default is never the reason a panel becomes a drawer; (3) the control rail width is reserved on both sides (geometry input rail, output gapX) so centering and the stacking decision include it; (4) a stacked workspace is one scroller (the document), panels follow as sections and stay visible; (5) a person's chosen size is still clamped for display only. The Summa reference geometry (src/ui/workspaceGeometry.ts) was updated to match and tested (scripts/test-workspace.mjs). Candidate P24 text should say panels yield before the region, not only that they shrink, then drawer, then stack.

classification.rationale: Refines the same gap as FB-0015 with measured evidence; the draft candidate P24 and the reference geometry had the weaker rule. Not a failure to apply approved guidance. Owner decides whether to merge into FB-0015. Confirmation needed.
